command.description: PowerShell command to run, e.g. Get-MpComputerStatus for antivirus status. Omit it when continuing a process (use pid).

pid.description: Process id from an earlier run_command that is still running or waiting for input.

input.description: Answer for a process that was waiting for input; only with pid.

timeoutSec.description: Seconds to wait for the result (default 30, max 300). The process is not killed when it expires.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory for a new command. Default: the user's home folder.
